notes.title: Playtest Extension
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello island architects,[/b][/h3][p]Daniel & Daniel from Thunderrock Innovations here again! We’re excited by the response to the [b]Islantiles (Demo) Playtest! S[/b]o many of you have signed up, sailed out, and shared fantastic feedback with us already.[/p][p]And because your adventures are just getting started, we’ve got some good news:[/p][h3][b]The Playtest is Being Extended![/b][/h3][p]Instead of wrapping up on [b]September 14, 2025 at 19:00 CET[/b], we’ll be keeping the playtest running until [b]September 21, 2025 at 19:00 CET[/b].[/p][p]That means two more weeks to explore islands, fine-tune your strategies, and uncover those satisfying deck-building combos.[/p][h3][b]Why the Extension?[/b][/h3][p]Your feedback has been incredible from bug reports to clever optimization ideas. Extending the playtest gives us (and you!) more time to test balance changes, polish features, and prepare the game for its next big steps.[/p][h3][b]Keep in Touch[/b][/h3][p]We’ll be rolling out small updates during the extension, so keep your eyes open for tweaks and surprises. As always, the best way to help is by sharing your thoughts with us:[/p][p]Drop feedback in our [url="https://discord.gg/n24hXgwhaW"]Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Registration Now Open for Islantiles!
notes.content:
[p]Hello aspiring island architects,[/p][p]
Daniel & Daniel from Thunderrock Innovations here! We’re absolutely excited to announce that [b]registration is now open[/b] for the [b]Islantiles (Demo) Playtest[/b]![/p][h3]Playtest Details[/h3][p][b]Playtest Period[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Starts:[/b] Today at 19:00 CET[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ends:[/b] September 14, 2025 at 19:00 CET[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Limited Slots – Rolling Access[/b]
We’ll be opening up the playtest in [b]waves[/b] to keep things running smoothly:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]first 200 players[/b] will set sail [b]today[/b]. So don’t wait, sign up right away![/p][/*][*][p]Additional batches of testers will be invited gradually throughout the playtest period, so if you don’t get in immediately, stay tuned your turn might be just around the corner.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Invite a Friend[/b]
Every playtester will receive the ability to [b]invite one friend via Steam[/b]. Exploring new islands is always better with company![/p][h3]What’s Inside the Playtest[/h3][list][*][p]You'll get access to an [b]early version of the demo[/b], featuring the first look at our cozy roguelite city-puzzler with deck-building mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Expect [b]frequent updates[/b], balancing tweaks, and new tech. Your feedback will help shape the game.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Why You’ll Love It[/h3][p]Islantiles marries [b]calm, relaxing gameplay[/b] with [b]deep strategic possibilities[/b]. You’ll:[/p][list][*][p]Settle beautiful islands.[/p][/*][*][p]Create and upgrade your deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Use powerful technologie combos.[/p][/*][*][p]Enjoy a quiet, thoughtful experience with no combat, no timer stress, and no citizen micromanagement. Just satisfying city-building and deck synergy [/p][/*][/list][p]This playtest is your chance to help us fine-tune our vision. Whether you're optimizing placements, discovering new synergies, or simply soaking in the cozy vibes: [b]We’d love your input[/b].[/p][h3]How You Can Help[/h3][list][*][p][b]Register now[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Wishlist and Follow[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Invite a friend[/b] to join you in exploring early builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jump into our Discord[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/n24hXgwhaW"]https://discord.gg/n24hXgwhaW[/url][/p][p]Chat with us, ask questions, post observations, and share your best combos.[/p][/*][/list][p]Have fun,[/p][p]Daniel & Daniel[/p]
